lines.en: Meanwhile...
Two bisexuals were sitting on a bed, not being bisexual at each other because life is cruel and sometimes girls don’t kiss each other even when everyone knows they should.
That said, this didn’t mean they weren’t thinking about kissing girls, though.
For Uta was a somewhat closeted pervert who had a baseline level of always thinking about things like that, whereas it was a relatively new phenomenon for Chika.
She’d always been open to the possibility of such a thing. Just it seemed like more of an actual possibility now that she’d gotten a literal taste of what life like that could be like.
This made her sad, though. It made her feel unclean. Because even if the man she loved would routinely do the same to her, Chika never believed she would follow suit.
But she also never believed she could change so much in such a short span of time, and she was finally, albeit somewhat reluctantly, coming around to the fact that she actually had.
What did this change of perspective mean for her, though? And would he find her actions as disloyal and despicable as she did?
Would he break up with her if that happened? And, if he did, would that feel more like being set free rather than being hurt?
For the hurt would come regardless — and it came quite frequently at that. But it was only because she had grown weak in her complacency. And she still had room to grow.
She had a lot to think about. And now that the girl these thoughts centered around had left the beach, there was little to do but drown in her excited uncertainty.
: Uta, can I ask you a question?
: No, I will not swap shifts with you next weekend. My customers depend on Uta-chan to find the will to keep on living. I’m afraid I can not let them down.
: It’s not about work. I was just wondering if you’ve ever hooked up with a girl before.
: Wha- huh?! Where did that...uhh...me?! Why?! What’s happening?!
: I’ve just been a little...curious lately, I guess. Just wanted to know if you have any experience.
: Uhh...well...I...umm...
: If you...really want to, and...we keep it a secret, I...
: Suppose we could try?...
: Hm? Try what? What do you mean?
: What do you mean?! Before I dig myself into a deeper hole!
: Ugh...I wish I knew how to talk about it without just...giving everything away.
: I...don’t mind if you...give everything away.
: You can even be extremely explicit and describe things in vivid detail if that helps you feel more comfortable talking about them.
: Mnh...no. I don’t want it to impact the way you look at me.
: I do.
: It’s just, like...Wouldn’t dating someone from our class be, like...way more convenient than dating some...I don’t know. Let’s just say an older guy for an example.
: Well yeah, but...dating’s not about convenience, right? It’s about, like...love and stuff.
: Right. But assuming you love two people and one of them just makes infinitely more sense than the other...then what? What would you do?
: Uh...I...I really don’t know...I’ve never felt that way about more than one person at a time before.
: Ugh! Me neither! That’s why I’m so confused!
: Chika...do you actually, like...have feelings for somebody that isn’t Sensei? Specifically a...girl from our class?
: I don’t know...maybe? We’re close as friends though and I don’t want it to, like...fuck anything up.
: Ohhh...cool. Cool, cool. Yeah, that makes sense. (Internally screaming, horny, and suddenly getting the wrong idea.)
: Also, if you tell anyone about this, I will kill you.
: I...won’t tell anyone about...anything you say in here, Chika...
: I also, um...well, you know...And it’s not like you can just stop how you’re feeling, so...I think just being honest is probably...um...for the best?...Maybe?...
: Do you...want to, like...come a little closer or something? J...Just so we can be, like...extra sure nobody hears.
: No, I’m fine over here. Nobody else is in the room. Thanks, though.
: I just wish she was still here, you know? Like, her leaving threw my whole weekend off.
: Wait. Leaving? But that would mean-
: Oh my God! You like Rin!
: Well...yeah. Maybe. Who else would I be talking about?
: Nobody! Definitely not anyone you work with! That would be inappropriate and wrong!
: It’s inappropriate and wrong either way, though! I already have a boyfriend! I just got swept up in the moment and wanted her to know she’s loved!
: Sensei hooks up with other girls all the time. I can be forgiven for just doing it once, right?
: So...you guys actually, like...hooked up?
: .......Yeaaaaah.
: Among...other things.
: .......Other things?
: It is......possible that I may have......uh......
: Performed oral sex on her?
: Uta?
: Yes?
: You’re not going to tell anybody, right? Because I’m really putting myself out there by admitting this to you right now.
: Secret’s safe with me. I don’t think I’d be able to repeat that out loud if I tried.
: Ever since then, I...I don’t know. Like...I don’t want to feel so...attracted to her. But I also kind of feel, like...like I’ve maybe felt this way for a while and...I’ve just been hiding from it?
: And now she’s saying she likes Sensei and it’s, like...what do I even do? I don’t want to just forget that ever happened between us. It was...special for me.
: I’m sure you’ve, um...thought about this already...but I highly doubt Sensei would be opposed to, like...you know...both of you. At once.
: If you’re talking about a threesome, then yes. He’d be all for it.
: But, like...See, this is where it gets weird. Because thinking about him doing stuff like that with her pisses me off. Like, I want her to be off limits.
: And since she’s the one I’m worried about in that scenario, doesn’t that mean I like her on a level maybe even higher than the one I like him on? I don’t get it.
: This, uhh...this sounds pretty serious, Chika. Have you, like...talked to her about it? Because Rin liked you for a really long time, didn’t she?

: A really long time. So now I feel like a fucking asshole because what I did rightfully confused the hell out of her at the same time she’s starting to be honest with herself about her feelings for Sensei.
: That’s not what I wanted to do, though! Like...I don’t want to confuse her! She has enough going on as-is. And I still love Sensei too!
: So it’s, like...do I just drop this? What would you do in my shoes?
: It’s...hard to answer that question when I’ve never been in a situation like that.
: I think the two of us are kind of similar in...how we like people, though. Because I’m also really obsessive when it comes to stuff like that. Just maybe not as...possessive as you?
: You think I’m possessive?
: Of course. That’s why you don’t want Sensei touching Rin, right? And why you didn’t want anyone touching Sensei before eventually giving up on that.
: Is that really visible to other people? I thought I did a good job of hiding it.
: I honestly can’t tell if you’re joking or not.
: Ugh...this whole thing just sucks. And I, like...can’t even be mad at Sensei anymore since I’m doing the same thing he is.
: Chika...I don’t think hooking up with Rin one time is anywhere near the level of what Sensei is doing. I think you just made a mistake.
: Was it a mistake, though?...Because that’s the part I can’t figure out. I want more of her. I’m just afraid to act on it because I don’t know how she or Sensei would feel.
: And that’s not even accounting for the general grossness I feel coming onto her in the first place after straight up rejecting her years ago. I don’t deserve her at all after that.
: You’re being too hard on yourself for just...having feelings, Chika. We all do things that make ourselves feel gross sometimes. That doesn’t mean you actually are, though.
: Easy for you to say when you’ve never done anything like that before.
: At least not as far as I know. But I live in a state of perpetual skepticism about which of my friends are fucking my boyfriend now. So I doubt I’d be surprised if you had. No offense.
: I’ve never...done anything like that with a boy or...a girl or...anyone before. I can’t take initiative the way you can. I just suffer in silence while everyone else finds happiness.
: As a rival, I’m relieved to hear that. But as your friend, I think it’s important for you to know that practically no one would ever refuse a girl like you, Uta.
: If you actually did take initiative every once in a while, I wouldn’t be surprised if you pulled ahead of everyone we know. You’re just depriving yourself at this point.
: Unfortunately, you’re overestimating just how desirable a girl like me is. Everything about you screams “wife.” I just exist as fodder for people to get their rocks off to.
: Woah! That’s not true at all. I’m sure you’ll make somebody the happiest man or woman in the world one day. Just keep me away from them or I might fuck both.
: Won’t have to since chances are you’ll get to them before me. I’ll be on the lookout, though.
: Do you want to vent now? My turn is over.
: I feel a lot better now that I’ve actually got to talk to somebody about all of this. Even if I’m still just as fucked as I was before. Literally and figuratively.
: I’m okay, Chika. You’re not the only one afraid of how people will see you when they find out what you really are.
: Well, what the hell is that supposed to mean? You’re not, like...secretly embezzling money from the maid cafe or robbing your customers blind, are you?
: There’s no need to — for Uta-chan is already the perfect maid. Embezzlement is for girls like Ami who come in last place on the rankings and try to kiss you in the locker room.
: God, imagine how many of our problems would be solved if she was obsessed with you instead of her fucking uncle.
: I’m surprised you still see her as a problem at all now that you know Sensei gets around faster than a 10-speed bike.
: Also, he’s her dad. And if you really love him, you’ll honor his wishes by going along with that even if you don’t like Ami very much.
: Oh, right. I forgot you actually do. Seems like mostly everybody else has given up on her by now.
: Uta-chan’s not the type to give up on anybody. Especially sad girls with questionable sexual preferences as we have learned here today.
: We’re an entire class of sad girls with questionable sexual preferences, though. We need to draw the line somewhere, don’t we?
: Learning how to accept Ami is a problem for future-Chika. You know — the one who stays with Sensei and lets the girl she’s way more compatible with get away.
: Is that really a future you’d be happy with, Chika? Waiting at home all by yourself just to have him come back smelling like another girl?
: At least with enough practice, I’ll know who’s who based on scent alone and can properly send out threatening letters to the correct addresses.
: And if he comes home smelling like Rin? Then what?
: I will either strangle him to death or passionately suck him off to further indulge in that scent.
: I am currently leaning toward the former, but am open to growing into a more accepting lover in the future.
: You’ll figure this out, Chika. I know you will. You’re the most mature out of everybody when you’re not acting all crazy and trying to murder the competition. Or your partner.
: Weirdly enough, I feel more sane right now than I have in a really long time. Only a matter of time until that streak is broken, though.
: Rin’s really gunning for him now and it is forcing me into a state of jealousy that makes me very frustrated both sexually and emotionally.
: If I was the type to take initiative, I might offer to lend a hand with both of those things right now.
: And I might agree because knowing you have to take care of yourself all the time makes me feel very bad for you.
: I can guarantee you that no one feels worse about this than myself!
: Let’s get dinner before things get even more explicit, though. You should understand the weight of your words when it comes to a permanent virgin like me.
: There’s always Ami.
: Didn’t I just say a little while ago that doing stuff like that with people you work with is inappropriate and wrong?
: Yeah, you did. That’s normally the stuff that’s the hottest, though.
: Ugh...I really hate how right you are.
Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!
Chika’s affection has increased as well! Just with the caveat that she thinks of someone else sometimes.
I’m sure that won’t hurt you at all, Frog Boy.
